required_repairs_before_dispatch: Pin the exact helper child bytes in a fresh freeze and execution map; helper_root alone is insufficient.
Bind a non-empty contiguous original-gate prefix and the observed target PID into the terminal summary.
Keep editor target exit UNKNOWN when no target receipt exists; never copy helper exit.
Remove CreationTime/GrantedAccess/HandleCount/PointerCount/PagedPoolCharge/NonPagedPoolCharge from causal timing logic because Microsoft marks them Reserved for OS use.
Use only documented PSS fields and retain identity UNKNOWN unless a documented identity proof exists.
stop_conditions: Missing target receipt or ambiguous process identity
Collector error after engine terminal: repair derived metadata from raw, do not rerun engine
Any first original-gate failure: seal raw and stop before retry
next_action: Implement and test the fresh helper contract in a separate review-only folder, then have the coordinator re-review it before considering one bounded diagnostic. No formal retry is authorized by this artifact.
